MATHEMATICS
FIRST TERM
WEEK 3
PRIMARY 2
THEME - WHOLE NUMBERS
PREVIOUS LESSON - Identification, Counting and Writing Numerals 101 to 200 (Primary 2)
TOPIC - COUNTING AND WRITING NUMBERS UP TO 200
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Recognition of Numbers from 1 - 200
3. Reading and Writing Numbers from 1 - 200
4. Weekly Assessment
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives - recognize, read and write from 1 - 200.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
Counting, Reading and Writing of Numbers
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of charts of written whole numbers.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information - Mathematics (Primary 2)

LESSON 4 - CONTINUATION OF LESSON 3
Repeat the activities in lesson 3.
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Displays some collections of different objects.
3. Lets pupils identify each of objects.
4. Leads to count the number of different collections.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify and count each of the collection.
5. Display flash cards representing the total number of each collection.
6. Ask pupils to match each card number with respective number of collection.
Pupil’s Activities - Match the card number with the appropriate number of each collection.
7. Displays chart showing whole number 1 - 50, 50 - 100 and 101 - 200.
8. Helps the pupils to recognize, read and write up to 200.
Pupil’s Activities - Recognize, read and write up to 200.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Introduction to Place Values of Whole Numbers Up to 200 (Primary 2)
LESSON EVALUATION
Pupils to -
1. Read numbers from 1 - 200.
2. Identify numbers from 1 - 200.
3. count correctly numbers  from 1 - 200.
4. write numbers from 1 - 200.
